abilities.name: Sneaky Gitz
abilities.text: During the first round of combat in which Gruzbag ambushes their opponent, they may use their Stealth dice pool of 8 for any Test.

abilities.name: Uncontrollable Bionik Arm
abilities.text:
At the start of each of Gruzbag's Turns, roll 1d6 to determine what their uncontrollable Bionik Arm does. If the result is a 4 or 5 Gruzbag makes a Ranged Attack using that profile against a random target within range. Attacks made by the Uncontrollable Bionik Arm do not count as Actions.
1: Shockin' Glitch: Gruzbag suffers 1 Shock.
2-3: Nothin' Happened!
4: Burna: 10 +3 ED / Range 4-8-12 / Salvo 1 / Flamer, Waaagh!
5: Dakka: 8 +4 ED / Range 12-24-36 / Salvo 4 / Rapid Fire, Waaagh!
6: Controlled Burna-Dakka: Gruzbag fires both the Burna and Dakka profiles at a target of their choice in range. 10 +1 ED / Range 6 – 12 – 18 / Salvo 1 / Pistol, Waaagh!
